Must Love Dogs!!
At Tribe Wellness, we're more than just a tribe – we're a movement. Rooted in courage, empowerment, and integrity, we've pioneered solutions that transform the world's wellness brands into revenue-generating machines. We bridge the gap between brands and revenue by turning our clients’ customers into lifetime supporters, and we do that by turning good salespeople into great salespeople.
At Tribe Wellness Sales, we’re on a mission to help pets live longer, healthier lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here’s the catch: too many pet owners grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it or missing the guidance to make it work.

That’s where you, our Product Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, pets miss out on better health, owners lose confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You’re the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for pets and their people.

Sell: You’ll sell products and services for our pet client, a company built for pet owners, by pet owners, with over a million happy dogs and growing!
Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients’ prospects into brand loyalists.
Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.
Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential to integrate with our operations seamlessly.
Live: Work from home in a global remote environment, utilizing our communication tools and platforms.

Earnings: This is an hourly pay + commission role. All US sales reps earn minimum wage (this is permanent, not a draw against commission) in addition to sales commissions, based on your monthly sales. On-target-earnings are estimated between $55,000 - $100K your first year. In addition to the above, we offer fully paid training.
Tribe Sales Training: We have a battle-tested training and tool kit we provide for all our sales consultants, including sales training through our learning platform, Rippling, Salesforce, Vonage, Google Workspace, and Slack, ensuring you're primed for success the second you hit the phones.
Remote Work: You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.
Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success. Check our team success stories here !

Hard-working and highly driven individuals who embody Tribe's core values.
Knowledge, background, or raw passion around health and wellness.
Experience in sales is an advantage, but with our comprehensive tool kit, we welcome those hungry to learn and grow.
A self-starter, motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.
Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication skills and a knack for building genuine connections.
You'll need a stable internet connection capable of supporting seamless voice and video communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater ( https://chromium.github.io/octane/ ).
A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with a working mic, camera, and a working headset.
The ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.
Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of pet health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Take the shot today and work with a very different type of company.

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
As a Business Development Representative at Upbound , you will own early-stage pipeline generation and serve as the first touchpoint in the sales cycle. You’ll play a critical role in growing our pipeline by engaging high-intent prospects who have shown interest in Crossplane , while also sourcing and developing new opportunities through targeted outbound efforts.
In this role, you will qualify inbound leads, execute focused outbound outreach, and set up high-quality discovery conversations for the sales team. You’ll build meaningful relationships within the community, research and engage target accounts, and support events, sales operations, and special projects.

Serving as a key bridge between Marketing and Sales , your primary mission is to generate qualified pipeline and help fuel Upbound’s growth. You will report directly to the Head of BDR and work closely with both the Sales and Marketing teams.

Establish and maintain a collaborative, strategic partnership with the assigned AE’s.
Engage marketing-qualified leads, event attendees, and high-intent prospects through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.
Target prospects through research and personalization using email, phone, LinkedIn, Slack communities, and other channels.
Research accounts within defined segments and verticals to identify target personas and generate sales-qualified leads.
Book qualified meetings with IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders for the Account Executives you support.
Have meaningful discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges and articulate the value of Crossplane and Upbound.
Outbound and source your own leads through various channels using research and creatively to book meetings.

A Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related role.
Comfort operating in a technical environment; open source and/or infrastructure exposure is strongly preferred.
Hunter mentality, resourcefulness, and self-starter.
A genuine interest in building relationships, networking, and starting conversations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using sales and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Marketo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You’re familiar with Crossplane and/or Upbound
Familiarity with CNCF or other open source cloud-native projects.
You’ve worked at a Series A, B or C startup

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

Remote Business Development Representative Job Description About emagineHealth emagineHealth is a full-service marketing agency built exclusively for the life sciences industry. For more than 30 years, we have served pharma, biotech, medical device, diagnostics, and drug development services companies.

We are a team of approximately 50 people who show up every day to help the companies advancing health and wellbeing worldwide tell better stories and build stronger commercial functions. The Role We are looking for a Business Development Representative who thinks like a marketer and sells like a strategist.

This person will own the new business pipeline, from prospecting through close, and will be the external face of everything we are building at emagineHealth.

We are hiring someone who genuinely understands the way marketing creates commercial value in the life sciences, who can diagnose a client's challenge before they even articulate it, and who can walk into a room of senior decision-makers and credibly represent the thinking behind our approach.

If you have run marketing at a life sciences agency, or served as a marketing strategist and then moved into sales, you are exactly who we are describing. The industry knowledge is a bonus. The marketing knowledge and consultative sales approach is non-negotiable. Responsibilities This is an autonomous role. You run your own pipeline.

You are responsible for outreach, discovery, proposal development, and close. You will work closely with the VP of Commercial Strategy on deal strategy, with the account management team on handoffs, and with our management team on crafting pitches.

Day-to-day, that looks like: Building and managing a qualified pipeline of life sciences prospects (CDMOs, CROs, biotech, pharma, med device, diagnostics, and eClinical companies), targeting marketing and commercial decision-makers at the VP and C-suite level Running discovery calls that actually uncover the client's business problem, not just their project list.

You diagnose before you prescribe. Leading proposal and pitch development in partnership with the VP of Commercial Strategy. You do not just oversee the deck, you shape the narrative. You know why the story matters, not just how to build the slides.

Managing 3 to 9 month deal cycles across multiple stakeholders (marketing, BD, commercial leadership, procurement, medical affairs, etc.). You know how to navigate a buying committee. Identifying expansion opportunities within the sales process. You can see a broader AOR relationship where a client initially sees a single project.

Maintaining CRM hygiene and providing accurate pipeline forecasting. You own your numbers. Representing emagineHealth at industry conferences (CPHI, BIO, SCOPE, and others) with the goal of building a network of executives who already know us before they need us. Acting as the internal bridge between market intelligence and service delivery.

You surface what you are hearing in the market and you bring that back to the team so our capabilities stay aligned with what buyers actually need. Who We Are Looking For There is a profile of a person that will succeed here and a profile of person that will not. We are being direct about both.

Marketing Foundation: You understand how marketing works. You have either run marketing programs yourself or you have sat close enough to the strategy side that you can speak to brand positioning, digital channels, content strategy, and why the website matters before you even think about paid media.

Sales Instinct: You know how to qualify fast, follow up without being annoying, read a room, and push a deal forward without pushing the prospect away. You understand that consultative selling in a relationship-driven industry like life sciences is a long game and you have the patience and the discipline for it.

Autonomy: You do not need hand holding. You figure things out. When you hit an obstacle, you first try to brainstorm a solution and then consult others. Agency life is fast and sometimes ambiguous, and you are comfortable in that environment. You build your own structure where structure does not yet exist. Speed: This is an agency.

Response time matters. Follow-through matters. You are someone who moves quickly, keeps commitments, and makes it easy for people to work with you. Commercial Intelligence: You understand pricing, margins, and what makes a deal actually profitable.

You understand that the deals you bring in affect the financial health of the organization, and you take that seriously. Executive Presence: You can hold a room. You are comfortable presenting to CMOs, VPs of Commercial, and founders who have strong opinions. You do not shrink when challenged.

You come prepared, and when you do not know something, you say so and get back to them. Industry Experience Life sciences experience is strongly preferred. If you have worked in pharma, biotech, CRO, CDMO, or adjacent sectors (either in-house or at an agency serving those clients), you are ahead of the curve.

If you do not have deep life sciences experience but have a strong marketing and sales background within B2B clients, let’s have a serious conversation. The industry can be learned. The mindset cannot. What Success Looks Like in Year One A qualified pipeline is built and actively moving.

You are running multiple deals at different stages simultaneously. You have attended at least one major industry conference and have meaningful new relationships to show for it. You met or exceeded your Quota. The VP of Commercial Strategy trusts you to run deals independently and looks to you as a thought partner on pipeline strategy.

The internal team sees you as a partner, not someone who overpromises during the sale and underdelivers at kickoff. You have contributed at least one piece of market intelligence that has meaningfully shaped our positioning or service approach.

Perks of Joining the emagine Team Opportunity to collaboratively work with top-tier talent A “family-like” environment will make you feel at home from your first day No micromanaging or breathing down your neck A culture of trust, appreciation for one another, and respect A company that recognizes that work can’t always be fun, but strives every day to keep it fun and enjoyable On the job training and development Medical and Dental insurance 401(k) with match Graduated PTO/Vacation Policy Professional Development reimbursement Employee referral incentive “HeyTaco” app on Slack allows employees to give thanks, praise and accolades to coworkers and cashed in for rewards or donated to charity Competitive salary Fitness/Wellness Reimbursement Paid vacation Personal days Opportunity to give back to the community **U.S. based applications only please.

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1st, 2026 you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Water division (Nalco Water, an Ecolab company), Ecolab delivers water treatment, process and digital water management solutions to help customers improve operational performance, protect critical assets and advance sustainability goals. Our solutions support customers across industrial, manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, energy, mining, data-centers and commercial facilities, from water intake through reuse and discharge.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and technical advisor to your customers. You will provide expert guidance on water treatment, process optimisation and digital water management programs that help improve operational performance, protect critical assets and support safe, efficient and sustainable customer operations.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn how customers’ systems work, gaining hands-on experience with equipment, technologies and solutions used in their daily operations
Support the installation, maintenance and safe use of equipment, helping customers keep their facilities fully operational
Train and support customer teams, making sure they feel confident using Ecolab solutions
Gradually develop the ability to spot improvement opportunities, deliver technical demonstrations and support the growth of your assigned territory
Work closely with colleagues across different teams (Sales, Marketing Services, Customer Service) to deliver the best possible customer experience
Contribute to Ecolab’s growth by supporting outreach activities and helping build our brand in your local market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:
Have completed technical / scientific education (Ideally in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry)
Are interested in building a career in technical, sales or service-related roles
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have basic IT skills (Microsoft Office)
Have at least a B1 level in English
Hold a valid driver’s license, with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record, and are open to traveling within your assigned district and occasionally nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

A 12month fixed-term contract, that may lead to a permanent position, depending on business needs
A robust, structured training programme, that includes job shadowing, e-learning modules, structured field activities, and customized classroom style training, with clear development milestones
A supportive environment where coaching and feedback are part of everyday work, allowing you to learn from subject matter experts with proven success
The opportunity to carve out a long term, advanced career path in sales, within a business that recognises the talent to progress
25 days holiday plus 8 days Bank Holiday
4% Flexible Benefits Allowance. A wide range of benefits (extended to families) or to be used as salary increase
Pension with 7% Employer Contribution and 4 x annual salary Life Insurance benefits
Receive a company vehicle for business and personal use
Income growth opportunities as you progress and develop in the role
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are diverse and inclusive, and we are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants.

We recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement on the basis of individual qualifications and job performance.

In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, colour, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

Eaton ’s GEIS division is currently seeking a Sales Representative. This is a remote position for candidates currently residing in Kansas City, MO. Relocation within the United States is provided for this role.

This position is accountable to create specification preference on upcoming projects with large Engineering Procurement Companies (EPCs) in the Kansas City market. The position will contribute to the regional sales quota and be measured against sales of Crouse-Hinds and B-Line electrical products inside the assigned customer base of EPCs.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $99000 - $145000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program. Please note the salary information shown is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

In addition to the primary responsibility calling on large EPCs focused on O&G and power generation market segments and position will also call on electrical wholesale distributors that support the assigned EPC customer base. Other customer responsibilities in the market will include interaction with manufacturers reps, end users, engineering firms, contractors and OEMs.

Create specification and technical preference for Crouse-Hinds and B-Line by holding specific product trainings for LED Lighting, Control and Apparatus, Cable Tray, and the rest of the Crouse Hinds and B Line portfolios.
Perform lighting audits with our large strategic end user customers by going through their facility for inspection of current lighting and propose new lighting plan.
Conduct trainings with end user customers specifically around Class 1 Div 1 & 2 environments and demonstrate which GEIS products belong in each area.
Plan and allocate time for sales activities with each distributor, major account, and to each major job, in an assigned territory or on assigned accounts based on sales potential.
Investigate and report on new product potential, competitive conditions and market possibilities for all GEIS products.
Develop and conduct training seminars with end-users, Contractors, Agents, ECH direct sales teams and distributors to grow the business and strengthen specification talent and expertise.
Maintain acceptable price/margin levels in territory, and control travel & entertainment costs. Have specific targets for sales, training, and key customer development.
Coordinate specification activities and collaborate with ECH direct sales team and agents (if applicable) to achieve the sales objectives, current and new product quotas, and properly implement sales plans.
Create a demand (specifications) for Crouse-Hinds products with potential and assigned accounts classified as: industrial, electrical contractor, constructor, architect/engineer and government.
Be familiar with competitor’s products and prices, and continuously increase knowledge of Crouse-Hinds products and their application advantages to customer needs.
Conduct user investigations, train, provide support to Crouse-Hinds Sales teams and focused distributors.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
Minimum of three (3) years of electrical/industrial experience (inside sales, outside sales/project quotations/marketing/field work).

Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1, H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, 1-485 job profitability, etc.

Ma matinée s'est très bien passée. Le premier rendez-vous consistait à présenter le SIBIR à un important propriétaire immobilier. Ce fut une rencontre agréable, au cours de laquelle j'ai réussi à susciter l'intérêt du propriétaire pour SIBIR et à le convaincre de notre offre.
Quel rôle jouez-vous en tant que responsable régional des ventes chez SIBIR ?
En tant que responsable régional des ventes, je suis chargé de l'accompagnement complet et du soutien des clients professionnels et privés dans la région de Zurich et de la Suisse centrale.

Mon domaine de responsabilité ne se limite pas seulement à l'entretien des relations clients existantes, mais inclut également la tâche cruciale d'acquérir de nouveaux clients dans ma zone de compétence.

Cette double mission exige une approche globale afin de garantir que tant les clients actuels que potentiels bénéficient du meilleur service et conseil possible.
Avec quels départements travaillez-vous particulièrement en étroite collaboration ?
Dans mon travail quotidien, je collabore étroitement avec la planification du service et le service commercial interne. L'échange régulier avec ces départements est essentiel pour assurer un traitement sans accroc.

Tant dans la planification que dans le service commercial interne, des collègues expérimentés et professionnels travaillent ensemble pour offrir un service optimal à nos clients et répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Cette coopération étroite permet une coordination efficace des processus et garantit que nous pouvons répondre de manière flexible aux besoins de nos clients.
Quelles tendances observez-vous dans les produits SIBIR ?
Les produits SIBIR mettent clairement en avant les tendances de la Swissness, de l'élégance ainsi que d'un design simple et épuré. Ces éléments représentent une promesse de qualité. La focalisation sur la simplicité et l'épuration souligne non seulement la convivialité des produits, mais reflète également un design intemporel.

Ces tendances visent à garantir que les produits SIBIR ne soient pas seulement fonctionnels, mais aussi esthétiquement attrayants et en accord avec les normes élevées de la tradition de fabrication suisse.
Et dans le domaine du service toutes marques ?
Dans l'évolution actuelle du service toutes marques, des tendances claires se dégagent. Un souhait croissant des clients est de recevoir tous les services regroupés et fournis par un seul interlocuteur. La nécessité d'avoir un point de contact unique pour divers besoins prend de plus en plus d'importance.

Il est notable que le prix n'est souvent plus au centre des préoccupations. Les clients accordent plutôt une importance accrue à un traitement professionnel et efficace de leurs demandes, ce qui est considéré comme une valeur ajoutée.

Cela illustre un déplacement des considérations purement financières vers un accent renforcé sur la qualité globale du service et la simplicité du traitement.
Comment percevez-vous vos clients, qu'ils soient administrations ou particuliers ?
Mes expériences avec mes clients, qu'il s'agisse d'administrations ou de particuliers, sont globalement positives. Je suis heureux de pouvoir dire que j'entretiens des relations très agréables avec nos clients chez SIBIR.

La collaboration avec les administrations et les particuliers se déroule de manière positive, et j'apprécie la possibilité de contribuer à leur satisfaction. Je me réjouis de continuer à soutenir nos clients avec enthousiasme à l'avenir et de poursuivre ces expériences positives de collaboration.
Cela nécessite certainement des mesures de vente individuelles. Les développez-vous seul ?

Lors du développement des mesures de vente, il est toutefois important de noter que chaque client a des besoins différents. Il est donc indispensable d'être flexible et d'utiliser les mesures de vente appropriées au bon moment. Cela exige de chaque membre de l'équipe de la sensibilité et de la flexibilité.
Concernant la durabilité : comment pourrait-on économiser davantage de CO2 ?
Spécialement dans le contexte des appareils ménagers, je souhaite souligner les points suivants : prolongation de la durée de vie des appareils : la garantie des pièces détachées de SIBIR suit déjà une voie très positive avec nos clients. Ces approches durables sont non seulement en accord avec les objectifs environnementaux, mais démontrent également notre engagement commun pour un avenir respectueux des ressources.
La réparation des machines cassées a-t-elle aujourd'hui une plus grande importance ?

K1x is the leading data distribution platform for alternative investments and a Fast Company Most Innovative Companies 2025 honoree. Our mission is straightforward: digitize the K-1 ecosystem. Meet and exceed weekly and monthly KPIs for outreach volume, Sales Qualified Lead generation, and qualified meetings booked.
Review your own metrics regularly and refine your approach based on what the data tells you.
Market and Product Intelligence

Collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to share field insights and contribute to targeting and positioning strategy.
